comparison.objective: Tilt a cabinet shelf through a narrow opening and lower it onto four pins; candidate commissions a hydraulic axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests bimanual large-object roll, constrained insertion, leveling, and four-point placement. Candidate tests fine hex access, collar rotation, moving-socket reacquisition, locking, and iterative physical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires four-pin support, ≤1° level/square alignment, back placement, release, and a 1 s hold. Candidate requires repeated force-, travel-, rebound-, energy-, and drift-bounded carriage stops.
comparison.reason: No meaningful objective, mechanism, or success-outcome overlap beyond generic alignment.
